The abstract reports no difference in the antifolate SNPs 51I, 59R, 108N or 540E (P > 0.05). verification.note: in_vetted_csv says whether a finding's system_id is a row in the vetted associations CSV. That CSV holds only associations whose two variables are both grounded to a concept, so false is conclusive only for those. vetted: false marks a finding compared with its source paper and found mis-extracted; vetting_method says how it was found, and vetting_note says what was wrong.
